fields.label: Damage Styles
fields.description: Editor separator: Damage Styles. Groups nearby fields or commands; it has no runtime effect and requires no authored value or event call.
fields.writing: Editor grouping only. Preserve its empty value; changing it has no game effect.

fields.label: Default Style
fields.description: Which Damage Style do you want to set as default? Use 'Manual' to not use any styles at all.
fields.context: Select a Name from /Damage/DamageStyleList (BATTLE-P-23). Shipped names:Standard,Armor Scaling,CT,D4,DQ,FF7,FF8,FF9,FF10,MK,MOBA,PKMN. Match is case-insensitive. Manual or an unknown name uses the skill/item native damage formula. <Damage Style: Name> in the skill/item Note overrides this choice.

fields.label: Check Formulas?
fields.description: Checks for illegal mechanics inside of damage formulas? (ie. gainHp, loseHp, addBuff, addDebuff, addState, etc)
fields.context: During Scene_Boot database completion, scans skill/item damage formulas for state-changing calls and shows a browser alert identifying each item. It neither blocks nor rewrites the formula. Disable only if these side effects are intentional; previews and auto-battle may evaluate formulas too.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Name of this Damage Style. Used for notetags and such.
fields.context: Name identifies a damage-style entry in /Damage/DamageStyleList (BATTLE-P-23). Match is case-insensitive. Use unique names; if duplicated, the last entry wins. Skills/items select it with <Damage Style: Standard> in Note; an absent style falls back to the native formula.

fields.label: JS: Formula
fields.description: The base formula for this Damage Style.
fields.context: Called while Game_Action evaluates its selected damage style. this is the Game_Action; arguments[0] is the target Game_Battler. Return signed numeric damage (negative for healing). Define locals explicitly, e.g. const a=this.subject(), b=arguments[0]; return Math.max(a.atk * 4 - b.def * 2, 0);. The function may also run for previews and auto-battle evaluation, so avoid state mutations. The nested fallback Formula is a template that refers to target; when writing a new body, define const target=arguments[0] before using that name. Shipped DamageStyleList entries carry their own complete formulas. No bare target/a/b variables are injected into this parameter callback. NaN results become0; a thrown formula error is logged with item/style context and falls back to the native item damage formula.

fields.context: The native FF8 formula contains historical let Value=0 followed by lowercase value assignments. Its serialized default is retained for configuration compatibility, not offered as a new-code template. When authoring a corrected equivalent body, declare let value=0 consistently; numeric comparisons use the shipped runtime behavior. Create named style entries here and select them with <Damage Style: Name> in a skill/item Note or /Damage/DefaultDamageStyle. Names match case-insensitively; last duplicate wins. Every Formula callback receives this=Game_Action and arguments[0]=target Game_Battler; return signed numeric damage. External item-menu display fields remain unavailable metadata. PKMN domain: keep the final defense/armor after modifiers strictly positive. Its shipped callback clamps armor to at least0 but divides attackStat by armor; a positive numerator with armor0 produces Infinity, not a finite damage value. The callback only converts NaN to0. Authors using PKMN must prevent zero armor or author a Formula callback that handles it explicitly; the native literal is preserved.

fields.label: Enable Soft Cap?
fields.description: Soft caps ease in the damage values leading up to the  hard damage cap. Requires hard Damage Cap enabled.
fields.context: Requires EnableDamageCap. Compresses damage above hardCap*DefaultSoftCap before applying the hard cap. DefaultSoftScaler controls curvature (BATTLE-P-40); <Bypass Soft Damage Cap> in skill/item/user trait Note skips compression but retains the hard cap.

fields.label: Base Soft Cap Rate
fields.description: The default soft damage cap used before applying damage.
fields.context: Fraction of hard cap at which soft compression begins, e.g. 0.8 with hard cap100 starts at80. Requires EnableDamageCap and EnableSoftCap. Signed Soft Damage Cap tags add to this fraction; the combined minimum is0.01. Damage/healing sign is restored after the cap.

fields.label: Soft Scale Constant
fields.description: The default soft damage cap used before applying damage.
fields.context: Controls compression above soft=hard*rate. For excess=absDamage-soft and scale=(hard-soft)*this constant, result is soft+max(excess*scale/(excess+scale),excess*0.01), then limited by the hard cap. Default0.1275, larger positive values compress less; use with /Damage/DefaultSoftCap (BATTLE-P-39).

fields.label: Popup Duration
fields.description: Adjusts how many frames a popup stays visible.

fields.label: Newest Popups Bottom
fields.description: Puts the newest popups at the bottom.

fields.label: Appear Position
fields.description: Selects where you want popups to appear relative to the battler.

optionLabels.head: Head - At the top of the battler.
optionLabels.center: Center - At the center of the battler.
optionLabels.base: Base - At the foot of the battler.

fields.label: End Battle Show?
fields.description: Show or hide popups upon victory or escape? Used to hide battle-state removal popups.

fields.label: Offset X
fields.description: Sets how much to offset the sprites by horizontally. Negative values go left. Positive values go right.
fields.context: Offset in game pixels from the named component configured base position. X positive moves right; Y positive moves down;0 preserves the base position. One-time horizontal displacement in pixels from the battler popup anchor (head/center/base plus engine offset). Applies to each popup; PopupShiftX instead separates simultaneous popups.

fields.label: Offset Y
fields.description: Sets how much to offset the sprites by vertically. Negative values go up. Positive values go down.
fields.context: Offset in game pixels from the named component configured base position. X positive moves right; Y positive moves down;0 preserves the base position. One-time vertical displacement in pixels from the battler popup anchor (head/center/base plus engine offset). Applies to each popup; PopupShiftY instead separates simultaneous popups.

fields.label: Shift X
fields.description: Sets how much to shift the sprites by horizontally. Negative values go left. Positive values go right.
fields.context: Horizontal separation in pixels when another popup is added. With NewPopupBottom=true existing popups shift by this amount; false places the new popup at the last popup position plus this shift. Positive right,negative left.

fields.label: Shift Y
fields.description: Sets how much to shift the sprites by vertically. Negative values go up. Positive values go down.
fields.context: Vertical separation in pixels when another popup is added. With NewPopupBottom=true existing popups shift; false offsets the new popup from the last popup. Positive down,negative up.

fields.label: Critical Flash Color
fields.description: Adjust the popup's flash color. Format: [red, green, blue, alpha]
fields.context: Evaluated once during plugin configuration as a JavaScript expression. Return [red,green,blue,alpha], four numbers in0..255. These bytes tint the critical damage popup; the default is a red flash. No battler or action arguments are available. Alpha0 means no flash contribution;255 is opaque flash color. This is a flash RGBA byte array, not normalized0..1 alpha.

fields.label: JS: Overall Formula
fields.description: The overall formula used when calculating damage.
fields.context: Called for each Game_Action.makeDamageValue(target,critical). this is Game_Action; arguments[0]=target battler, arguments[1]=critical boolean. Return signed numeric damage; variance/guard/critical behavior must be composed here as shown in the default. Example constant formula: return arguments[1] ? 200 : 100;.

fields.label: JS: Variance Formula
fields.description: The formula used when damage variance.
fields.context: Called by Game_Action.applyVariance. this is Game_Action; arguments[0]=signed damage, arguments[1]=variance percentage0..100. Return signed numeric damage. Example disabling variance: return arguments[0];. MZ Math.randomInt(n) is available and returns an integer in0..n-1 for positive n. Return a finite number; the default preserves the sign of healing.

fields.label: JS: Guard Formula
fields.description: The formula used when damage is guarded.
fields.context: Called by Game_Action.applyGuard. this is Game_Action; arguments[0]=signed damage, arguments[1]=target Game_Battler. Return signed numeric damage. Example preserving incoming value: return arguments[0];. target is Game_Actor/Game_Enemy; target.grd is its guard-effect special parameter. The default divides positive guarded damage by2*grd; avoid authored zero/negative guard rates if retaining that division.

fields.label: Critical Hits
fields.description: Editor separator: Critical Hits. Groups nearby fields or commands; it has no runtime effect and requires no authored value or event call.
fields.writing: Editor grouping only. Preserve its empty value; changing it has no game effect.

fields.label: JS: Rate Formula
fields.description: The formula used to calculate Critical Hit Rates.
fields.context: Called for a critical-enabled skill/item by Game_Action.itemCri. this is Game_Action; arguments[0]=target battler. Return probability as a fraction (0.25 means25%). After this callback, user trait JS Critical Rate as User then target trait JS Critical Rate as Target may change rate. Example fixed chance: return 0.25;. The engine compares this numeric result to a random number in0..1; values<=0 never succeed and>=1 always succeed, without implicit clamping. Return a finite0..1 fraction for ordinary probabilities.

fields.label: JS: Damage Formula
fields.description: The formula used to calculate Critical Hit Damage modification.
fields.context: Called by Game_Action.applyCritical. this is Game_Action; arguments[0]=signed pre-critical damage. Return the signed critical damage. Default composes damage*multiplier+bonusDamage after item/trait tags and JS Critical Damage. Example double damage: return arguments[0]*2;.

fields.writing: Editor grouping only. Preserve its empty value; changing it has no game effect.

fields.label: Base Troop ID's
fields.description: Select the Troop ID(s) to duplicate page events from for all other troops.
fields.context: Appends event pages from the listed troop IDs after the current troop own pages, in list order. Skips a base equal to the current troop ID and ignores missing IDs; duplicate listed IDs append duplicate pages. Does not recursively expand base-troop lists or import their enemy members. Earlier eligible pages win under native troop-page scheduling.

fields.label: Common Events (on Map)
fields.description: Editor separator: Common Events (on Map). Groups nearby fields or commands; it has no runtime effect and requires no authored value or event call.
fields.writing: Editor grouping only. Preserve its empty value; changing it has no game effect.

fields.label: Pre-Battle Event
fields.description: Common Event to run before each battle on map. Use to 0 to not run any Common Event at all.

fields.label: Post-Battle Event
fields.description: Queued Common Event to run after each battle on map. Use to 0 to not run any Common Event at all.
fields.context: A Common Event database ID;0 disables. On victory/defeat/successful escape, this event is reserved before the specific result event. It executes through the native common-event queue when interpreter processing resumes; game over can prevent return-map execution.

fields.label: Victory Event
fields.description: Queued Common Event to run upon victory on map. Use to 0 to not run any Common Event at all.
fields.context: A Common Event database ID;0 disables. Reserved after BattleEndEvent on victory and processed after battle as the native interpreter resumes.

fields.label: Defeat Event
fields.description: Queued Common Event to run upon defeat on map. Use to 0 to not run any Common Event at all.
fields.context: A Common Event database ID;0 disables. Reserved after BattleEndEvent on defeat. Random encounters allow losing when this is configured; Battle Processing events still use their Can Lose setting. A game-over transition does not run return-map common events.

fields.label: Escape Success Event
fields.description: Queued Common Event to run upon escape success on map. Use to 0 to not run any Common Event at all.
fields.context: A Common Event database ID;0 disables. Reserved after BattleEndEvent on successful escape; runs when the map interpreter resumes.

fields.label: Escape Fail Event
fields.description: Common Event database ID queued after each failed escape attempt. It can run during battle when event processing resumes; 0 disables it.
fields.context: A Common Event database ID;0 disables. Each failed escape reserves it on the native queue. It may run during battle when event processing resumes; it does not wait for battle end and repeated failures can enqueue repeated executions. BattleEndEvent is not queued on failure.

fields.label: Escape
fields.description: Editor separator: Escape. Groups nearby fields or commands; it has no runtime effect and requires no authored value or event call.
fields.writing: Editor grouping only. Preserve its empty value; changing it has no game effect.

fields.label: JS: Calc Escape Ratio
fields.description: Code used to calculate the escape success ratio.
fields.context: Called by BattleManager.makeEscapeRatio during battle setup. this is BattleManager; no arguments. Return initial probability as a fraction, e.g. return 0.5; for50%. Party/troop globals are initialized. No automatic clamping. The default divides by troop agility; use a guarded denominator in custom bodies if your database permits zero agility, e.g. return 0.5*$gameParty.agility()/Math.max(1,$gameTroop.agility());. Values>=1 guarantee escape;<=0 cannot succeed on that attempt.

fields.label: JS: Calc Escape Raise
fields.description: Code used to calculate how much the escape success ratio raises upon each failure.
fields.context: Called after each failed escape attempt with this=BattleManager and no arguments. Return the absolute increment added to the existing escape probability, not a multiplier. The shipped default is0.1 plus0.05 per living party member:0.2 for2 members and0.3 for4 members. An explicit return0.1 preserves a10-percentage-point increase. Authored callbacks are preserved; there is no automatic cap on the accumulated probability.

fields.writing: Editor grouping only. Preserve its empty value; changing it has no game effect.

fields.label: Switch: Critical
fields.description: Turns switch ON if the action performs a critical hit. Switch reverts to OFF whenever an action starts.
fields.context: Switch ID;0 disables tracking. Reset OFF at action start, then becomes ON if any applied target/hit is critical. Later noncritical hits do not reset it within the same action.

fields.label: Switch: Miss/Evade
fields.description: Turns switch ON if the action misses/is evaded. Switch reverts to OFF whenever an action starts.
fields.context: Switch ID;0 disables tracking. Reset OFF at action start, then becomes ON if any target/hit misses or evades; successful later hits do not clear it.

fields.writing: Editor grouping only. Preserve its empty value; changing it has no game effect.

fields.label: Variable: Damage
fields.description: Variable records target damage during action. Variable reverts to 0 whenever an action starts.
fields.context: Variable ID;0 disables tracking. Reset0 at action start, then sums positive result.hpDamage across every target/hit. MP/TP damage is excluded; records the action result, including overkill rather than clamping to target prior HP.

fields.label: Variable: Healing
fields.description: Variable records target healing during action. Variable reverts to 0 whenever an action starts.
fields.context: Variable ID;0 disables tracking. Reset0 at action start, then sums absolute negative result.hpDamage across target/hits. MP/TP recovery is excluded; positive damage does not subtract healing.

optionLabels.top: Top - Sprite is located at the top of the window.

fields.context: Selects the actor sprite base Y in the XP front-view status window. name places the base above the actor name; top uses Y0; bottom uses the face-area height; center centers the sprite vertically using the status inner height and loaded sprite height. fields.context: In side-view battles, true gives automatically sequenced physical single-target actions an approach, attack and return-home movement. It does not change damage, target selection or authored Custom Action Sequences. False keeps the normal forward step without approaching the target. The approach uses battler sprite widths, not the global MeleeDistance setting.

fields.label: Melee Multi Target
fields.description: Allow this auto sequence for physical, multi-target actions?
fields.context: In side-view battles, true gives automatically sequenced physical all-target actions an approach toward the target group, effects on the group and a return home. False keeps the forward step without approach. Front-view battles, magical/certain-hit actions and Custom Action Sequences do not use this automatic melee movement. Use AutoMeleeSolo for single-target actions.

fields.label: Auto Notetag
fields.description: Automatically apply the <Custom Action Sequence> notetag effect to any item or skill that has a Common Event?
fields.context: When true, a skill/item with a Common Event effect or named/keyed Common Event tag runs those events as its custom battle action sequence without requiring <Custom Action Sequence>. The author must put action effect and finish commands in that event; ordinary automatic damage is replaced. <Auto Action Sequence> in that skill/item Note opts it back into automatic sequencing. When false, custom sequencing requires <Custom Action Sequence>. This setting does not modify the database Note text. Concrete minimum example: set this parameter true; give a skill one Common Event effect pointing to an existing Common Event1 (illustrative ID). In that event insert ACTSET: Setup Action (ActSeq_Set_SetupAction, BATTLE-C-3), ACTSET: Whole Action Set (ActSeq_Set_WholeActionSet, BATTLE-C-4, ActionEffect=true), then ACTSET: Finish Action (ActSeq_Set_FinishAction, BATTLE-C-6), with their shipped defaults. The whole set applies the skill effect to all selected targets; finish releases temporary immortality and returns the subject home. End the Common Event normally after those commands. The skill pays its normal cost once; do not add another Action Effect unless another hit is intended. Inspect these exact command IDs with battle api describe to author their arguments. For a custom visual sequence without the whole set, ActSeq_Mechanics_ActionEffect with Targets=["all targets"] applies damage/effects before Finish Action.

During the battle action, user is its acting Game_Battler and targets are its selected targets. commands.label: CAMERA: Focus Target(s)
commands.description: Focus the battle camera on certain battler target(s). Requires ActSeqCamera 1.15 after Battle; battle scene only. Transforms are neutral during player input.

args.label: Targets
args.description: Select unit(s) to focus the battle camera on.
args.context: JSON string array of selectors, e.g. ["user","all targets"]. user is the action subject; current target is the current action-list index; prev/next use adjacent entries and fall back to current at a boundary. focus is user plus all targets; not focus is living battle members outside that set. alive/dead friends/opponents are relative to user; actors/enemies are absolute sides. index x is zero-based position in that unit; actor ID x/enemy ID x use positive database IDs (enemy ID selects every matching instance). Missing indices/IDs contribute nothing; duplicate selectors can repeat a battler. special aliases current target; the editor suggestion "special x" is reserved and is not a general indexed selector here. Prefer current target or the documented index forms. When several resolved battlers have sprites, focus is the arithmetic mean of their horizontal sprite positions and vertical centers (sprite y minus half its height), in battle-screen coordinates. It is not the first target or the bounding-box center. Camera offsets are applied separately.

commands.label: WEAPON: Next Weapon Slot
commands.description: Goes to next active weapon slot (making others invalid).

args.label: Targets
args.description: Select unit(s) to change the next active weapon slot for.
args.context: JSON string array of selectors, e.g. ["user","all targets"]. user is the action subject; current target is the current action-list index; prev/next use adjacent entries and fall back to current at a boundary. focus is user plus all targets; not focus is living battle members outside that set. alive/dead friends/opponents are relative to user; actors/enemies are absolute sides. index x is zero-based position in that unit; actor ID x/enemy ID x use positive database IDs (enemy ID selects every matching instance). Missing indices/IDs contribute nothing; duplicate selectors can repeat a battler. special aliases current target; the editor suggestion "special x" is reserved and is not a general indexed selector here. Prefer current target or the documented index forms.

args.label: Jump To Label
args.description: If a valid weapon is found after the index change, jump to this event label.
args.context: Nome exato de um comando nativo Label no mesmo evento/intérprete que executa este comando. Após mudar o índice, se houver arma ativa, salta para esse Label. Sem alvo/arma válido, ou se o Label não existir, continua no comando seguinte. Exemplo ilustrativo: Label Golpe antes do efeito e JumpToLabel=Golpe repetem o trecho enquanto houver próximo alvo/arma. O texto padrão Untitled só salta se esse Label existir. Planeje a condição de saída para evitar um loop sem avanço.

tags.description: Resolve ordered Common Event keys; missing keys add no event.
tags.context: Author the complete tag in the database Note. Author in Skills Note, Items Note. Use the complete tag text, preserving its angle brackets. Keys match [KEY] brackets in Common Event names, case-insensitively after trimming and removing icon escapes. Example key Slash selects an event named [Slash] Attack. Repeated IDs duplicate members; missing troop IDs are ignored. Author in Troops Name, Comment event command (108 with408 continuation) on the selected troop page. Use the complete tag text, preserving its angle brackets.

methods.description: Runs the configured Mechanics callback with this=battler, then matching trait notes. Note action=user.currentAction() (may be undefined), item/skill=current trait, user/target=self, value=0. Does not require battle. Callback return is ignored.
methods.context: Valid keys: PreStartBattleJS, PostStartBattleJS, PreEndBattleJS, PostEndBattleJS, PreStartTurnJS, PostStartTurnJS, PreEndTurnJS, PostEndTurnJS, PreRegenerateJS, PostRegenerateJS, BattleVictoryJS, BattleDefeatJS, EscapeSuccessJS, EscapeFailureJS. Unknown/non-string keys are ignored. The engine already invokes these at their phases; manually calling one repeats its authored side effects and does not advance the battle phase.

methods.description: Retorna o sprite real do battler da batalha corrente.
methods.context: Use on a Game_Actor or Game_Enemy in an active Scene_Battle after spriteset creation. Outside that context the return may be undefined; guard it before calling sprite methods.

methods.description: Cria texto no sprite do battler com textColor, flashColor e flashDuration opcionais.
methods.context: Call on an actor/enemy in an active battle, e.g. $gameParty.leader(). Optional settings: textColor is a Window palette index or CSS color (default #ffffff), flashColor is [r,g,b,a] with four0..255 bytes (default [0,0,0,0]), flashDuration is a nonnegative frame count (default0). With no associated sprite, this does nothing. Example: $gameParty.leader().setupTextPopup("Ready",{textColor:"#ffffff",flashColor:[255,0,0,128],flashDuration:30});.

methods.description: Consulta a imortalidade da sequência corrente.
Compara dtb/tpb sem diferenciar maiúsculas. TPB ativo e wait são tpb.
Seleciona string por peso opcional :n; preserva a lista.
methods.context: Input is an array of strings; an optional :N suffix assigns a nonnegative integer weight; omitted weight is1. Use at least one positive weight. Example ["A:2","B"] selects A with2/3 probability and B with1/3, returning only the selected name. Empty list returns an empty string; this does not resolve database IDs or assets.

methods.description: Aplica item uma vez, drena o log e restaura a ação corrente; não paga custo nem reserva CE global.
methods.context: For a plugin or Script command during an active battle, obtain the existing log from SceneManager._scene._logWindow. subject and target are living game objects, not database records; item is $dataSkills[id] or $dataItems[id]. Example: SceneManager._scene._logWindow.emulateActionEffect($gameParty.leader(),$gameTroop.members()[0],$dataSkills[1]); requires those records/battlers. This intentionally applies effects now; calling it in addition to native action application duplicates effects.

methods.description: Deslocamento vertical de float e jump, extensível por aliases.
methods.context: Use a live sprite from $gameParty.leader().battler(). Returns pixels: negative float height minus jump height; negative moves upward,0 is grounded. It is a computed query, not a setter.

methods.description: Geometria corrente da camada interna, incluindo escala assinada da sequência.
methods.context: Use a live battle sprite from battler.battler(). Returns internal bitmap/geometry width in pixels multiplied by mainSpriteScaleX(); signed scales are preserved, so width can be negative after a negative sequence scale. It is not an absolute screen bounding-box width.

methods.description: Geometria corrente da camada interna, incluindo escala assinada da sequência.
methods.context: Use a live battle sprite from battler.battler(). Returns internal bitmap/geometry height in pixels multiplied by mainSpriteScaleY(); a negative Y scale yields a negative height. It is not an absolute screen bounding-box height.

methods.description: Geometria corrente da camada interna, incluindo escala assinada da sequência.
methods.context: Use a live battle sprite from battler.battler(). Returns the sequence X scale as a signed factor (default1,0.5 half size,-1 flipped), separate from the outer sprite facing transform.

methods.description: Geometria corrente da camada interna, incluindo escala assinada da sequência.
methods.context: Use a live battle sprite from battler.battler(). Returns the sequence Y scale as a signed factor (default1,0.5 half height,-1 inverted).

methods.description: Renderiza um popup de texto no battler; settings contém textColor, flashColor e flashDuration.
methods.context: Requires a live battle sprite from $gameParty.leader().battler() and its attached parent. Supply settings={textColor:"#ffffff",flashColor:[255,0,0,128],flashDuration:30}; textColor accepts Window palette index or CSS color, flashColor is four0..255 bytes, flashDuration is nonnegative frames. All settings must be supplied to the sprite API; use Game_Battler.setupTextPopup for defaults.

methods.description: Renderiza ícone e texto no mesmo popup com settings normalizados.
methods.context: Requires a live battle sprite from $gameParty.leader().battler() and its attached parent. Supply settings={textColor:"#ffffff",flashColor:[255,0,0,128],flashDuration:30}; textColor accepts Window palette index or CSS color, flashColor is four0..255 bytes, flashDuration is nonnegative frames. All settings must be supplied to the sprite API; use Game_Battler.setupTextPopup for defaults. icon is a zero-based index in img/system/IconSet.png, e.g.64.

methods.description: Cria a camada interna do sprite; chamado na inicialização antes dos aliases dos consumidores.
methods.context: Lifecycle hook automatically called once while Sprite_Battler initializes. It creates a new internal child container each time, so do not call it on an already initialized live sprite. Plugin extensions should alias this method and call the previous implementation before adding their children; obtain live sprites via battler.battler() only for inspection.

methods.description: Avança a interpolação de opacidade; chamado por updateMain.
methods.context: Automatic updateMain hook; advances the active opacity tween by one frame, or does nothing if none. Configure the tween with the Battle Opacity action-sequence command; do not call this manually every frame in addition to native update. Inspect the sprite through $gameParty.leader().battler().

methods.description: Aplica os getters públicos de escala à camada interna; projeção SV delega ao inimigo externo.
methods.context: Automatic updateMain hook after distortion container creation; applies mainSpriteScaleX()/mainSpriteScaleY() to that container. A side-view enemy uses an inner actor-like sprite whose updateScale is intentionally empty: the outer enemy sprite owns the scale. Inspect live sprites via battler.battler(); manually calling does not start a tween.

methods.description: Cria os containers de battlers e animações inferiores durante a criação do campo.
methods.context: Automatic creation hook after the native battle field exists. Creates new battler/Under-animation containers; non-idempotent, so do not call again on SceneManager._scene._spriteset. Extensions alias the prototype hook, call the prior implementation once, then add children. The existing spriteset is available only in an active Scene_Battle.

methods.description: Ponto de alias após a criação do campo; o campo padrão permanece sem inversão.
methods.context: Automatic extension hook after battlefield/container creation; default implementation does nothing. An optional plugin may alias it, call the prior implementation and adjust this._battleField.scale.x/position consistently. It does not itself enable flipped battles. Inspect the current spriteset through SceneManager._scene._spriteset during Scene_Battle.

methods.description: Ordena battlers por prioridade e posição; chamado na atualização do spriteset.
methods.context: Automatic spriteset update hook; sorts living sprite children by configured actor priority, then Y position ascending, then spriteId descending for ties. Sprites without a battler go last; when enabled, acting actor moves last during action. Use SceneManager._scene._spriteset in an active Scene_Battle; no manual call is needed for ordinary authoring.

methods.description: Materializa description, statusDescription e excludeListing preservando o parser anterior.
methods.context: Runs automatically for loaded state database records. For dynamic Note changes pass the database object, e.g. call this method with $dataStates[1] after editing that record note. It is not a Game_Battler or state ID. Description defaults to "-"; absent optional tags do not clear previously populated statusDescription/excludeListing. Refresh any open status window after changing data.

methods.description: Escopo textual ALLY com alvos nos dois lados.
methods.context: Create a query action with const action=new Game_Action($gameParty.leader()); action.setSkill(1); (skill1 must exist), or inspect BattleManager._action during an action. Does not select targets or apply effects. Consume as Boolean(action.isForAnyone()) when a yes/no answer is needed. Returns a RegExp match array with [0]="ALLY" for a textual scope containing ALLY, null for other textual scopes, false for native numeric/no scope.

methods.description: Foco inimigo no escopo ENEMY OR ALLY.
methods.context: Create a query action with const action=new Game_Action($gameParty.leader()); action.setSkill(1); (skill1 must exist), or inspect BattleManager._action during an action. Does not select targets or apply effects. Consume as Boolean(action.isForAnyoneFocusOpponents()) when a yes/no answer is needed. Returns boolean true only for the textual scope ENEMY OR ALLY; false otherwise.

methods.description: Foco aliado no escopo ALLY OR ENEMY.
methods.context: Create a query action with const action=new Game_Action($gameParty.leader()); action.setSkill(1); (skill1 must exist), or inspect BattleManager._action during an action. Does not select targets or apply effects. Consume as Boolean(action.isForAnyoneFocusFriends()) when a yes/no answer is needed. Returns boolean true only for the textual scope ALLY OR ENEMY; false otherwise.

methods.description: Match da tag Cannot Target User.
methods.context: Create a query action with const action=new Game_Action($gameParty.leader()); action.setSkill(1); (skill1 must exist), or inspect BattleManager._action during an action. Does not select targets or apply effects. Consume as Boolean(action.isForNotUser()) when a yes/no answer is needed. Returns a RegExp match array with [0] equal to the matched Cannot Target User tag, or null if absent.

methods.description: Reconhece RANDOM ANY e escopos textuais de inimigos.
methods.context: Create a query action with const action=new Game_Action($gameParty.leader()); action.setSkill(1); (skill1 must exist), or inspect BattleManager._action during an action. Does not select targets or apply effects. Consume as Boolean(action.isForOpponentBattleCore()) when a yes/no answer is needed. Returns true for RANDOM ANY, a RegExp match array with [0] ENEMY or ENEMIES for other enemy-containing textual scopes, or null if neither/numeric scope.

methods.description: Encaminha animação normal/Under à camada de batalha respeitando AntiTint e Camera.
methods.context: Automatic createAnimation hook after the battle spriteset creates its containers. Pass the engine-created Sprite_Animation or Sprite_AnimationMV after setup, not an animation database record. Normal authoring requests animations with $gameTemp.requestAnimation(battlers,id); put <Under> in the Animations Name for the lower layer. AntiTint/Camera compatibility follows their active configuration. Extensions may alias this hook; manually reattaching a live animation changes its owner and is unnecessary.

methods.description: Keys PreApply%1JS, PostApply%1JS, PreDamage%1JS, PostDamage%1JS; arguments target,value,readOnly. Ordered parameter,item,user,target. Native PreDamage readOnly=false propagates value; other native calls readOnly=true ignore returned/assigned changes.
methods.context: Automatic action effect hook. For inspection obtain action=BattleManager._action during an action; target=$gameTroop.members()[0] is a Game_Enemy. It executes authored side effects, so do not call again alongside native application. With readOnly=false it returns the transformed number but does not apply HP/MP damage itself; native executeDamage owns caps, rounding and application. Unknown keys are invalid and can throw.

methods.description: Keys PreStartActionJS/PostStartActionJS/PreEndActionJS/PostEndActionJS. Parameter then current item then subject traits. this/action=Game_Action; target=user. Returns undefined.
methods.context: Automatic lifecycle hook; action=BattleManager._action during the action or a configured new Game_Action(actor) with setSkill(id). It executes authored effects but does not start/end the engine action. Calling it manually repeats hooks already called by BattleManager. Only the listed keys are valid; an unknown key can throw.

methods.description: Anexa arma, battler SV, imagem principal e animação injetada à camada de distorção. Hook do ciclo real de criação.
methods.context: Automatic creation/rebuild hook after createDistortionSprite and component creation. Reparents existing weapon/SV/main/inject children into the distortion container and leaves shadow outside. Repeating it reuses children, but an uninitialized sprite is invalid. Inspect an existing sprite via battler.battler(); normal authoring needs no manual call.

methods.description: Cria a imagem principal do inimigo e chama o hook de anexação.
methods.context: Automatic enemy initialization hook that creates a new main image sprite, then attaches it to the distortion layer. Non-idempotent: do not call on an existing sprite. For extensions alias the prototype and call the prior implementation once; inspect a live enemy sprite via $gameTroop.members()[0].battler().

methods.description: Reconstrói a apresentação SV do inimigo corrente e chama o hook de anexação.
methods.context: Automatically called by setBattler after enemy data and the distortion layer exist. Pass the same Game_Enemy associated with this sprite, e.g. enemy=$gameTroop.members()[0], sprite=enemy.battler(). It destroys/replaces the old SV child/shadow and creates them only if enemy.hasSvBattler(); no manual call is needed for normal setup/transform.

methods.description: Recria o aspecto lendo a nota do inimigo atual.
methods.context: Use on a live enemy, e.g. $gameTroop.members()[0]. Automatic enemy setup calls this. After dynamically changing that enemy database Note, calling it rebuilds aspect data; refresh the open In-Battle Status window to show the new data.

methods.description: Recria os defaults de aspecto com descrição vazia.
methods.context: Use on a live enemy from $gameTroop.members()[0]. Restores name from /Enemy/AspectNameFmt with %1=originalName(), iconIndex from /Enemy/AspectIcon, nameColor from /Enemy/AspectColor and description="". This removes the aspect entry from subsequent status-list refreshes until description is supplied.

methods.description: Retorna o objeto mutável com name, iconIndex, nameColor e description; transformação não o recalcula automaticamente.
methods.context: Use on a live enemy from $gameTroop.members()[0]. Returns {name:string,iconIndex:number,nameColor:string|number,description:string}; iconIndex is an IconSet index, nameColor is a Window palette index or CSS color. Mutations affect that enemy aspect; refresh an open status list afterward. Empty description hides its aspect entry.

methods.description: Indica se o aspecto tem descrição não vazia.
methods.context: Use on a live enemy from $gameTroop.members()[0]. Returns true exactly when its aspect description has nonzero length; name/icon alone do not qualify. Example: const enemy=$gameTroop.members()[0]; if(enemy.hasAspectData()) console.log(enemy.getAspectData().name);.

methods.description: Acrescenta a entrada de aspecto do inimigo atual se houver descrição; makeCommandList chama este método antes dos estados. Use refresh() para reconstruir a lista sem duplicar entradas.
methods.context: Lifecycle method on the actual state-list window after its selected battler has been set. Normal makeCommandList already invokes it. Calling it again can duplicate the aspect; call refresh() on that window after changing data instead.

methods.description: Retorna zero frames de atraso para animações da batalha; animações de estados usam o mesmo início e não herdam o espaçamento de mapa.
methods.context: Automatic engine animation scheduling query on the current SceneManager._scene._spriteset during battle. Returns0 frames; does not request or play an animation.

methods.description: Retorna zero frames de atraso para animações da batalha; animações de estados usam o mesmo início e não herdam o espaçamento de mapa.
methods.context: Automatic engine query for spacing between successive battle animations on the current SceneManager._scene._spriteset. Returns0 frames; it does not add a wait or play an animation.

methods.description: Executa o callback de mecânica e as notas dos membros do grupo, depois dos inimigos. BattleVictoryJS marca o encerramento antes dos callbacks.
methods.context: key: Chave de callback de Mechanics, como BattleVictoryJS. Ponto de extensão do fluxo de batalha. Use em um consumidor que substitui a fase correspondente; uma chamada adicional repete os efeitos autorais e não concede recompensas.

methods.description: Encaminha um callback de mecânica a cada membro atual da unidade, na ordem da unidade.
methods.context: key: Chave do callback de Mechanics. Ponto de extensão de Game_Party e Game_Troop. O fluxo normal já executa os callbacks; invocar novamente repete os efeitos autorais.

methods.description: Reserva BattleEndEvent e o evento do resultado, nessa ordem. EscapeFail reserva somente seu evento. Eventos vazios não são reservados.
methods.context: kind: Victory, Defeat, EscapeSuccess ou EscapeFail. Ponto de extensão para consumidores que substituem a fase de resultado. Reserva os eventos configurados; não executa o intérprete nem concede recompensas.

methods.description: Oculta a camada de janelas de combate fora da área visível ou restaura sua posição centralizada.
methods.context: visible: true restaura a camada; false a desloca para fora da tela. Disponível na cena de batalha após criar a camada de janelas. Não altera a visibilidade de filhos adicionados diretamente à cena, como as janelas de vitória.

methods.description: Cria a janela real de comandos do grupo e registra os handlers de batalha. Consumidores podem encadear este ponto para registrar seus próprios handlers.
methods.context: Hook de criação chamado por createPartyCommandWindow durante a montagem de Scene_Battle. Não chamar após a janela já existir: criaria uma segunda janela.

methods.description: Lê os equipamentos completos do ator usando a função preservada antes do filtro de arma ativa de BattleCore. Não altera o equipamento nem a seleção de arma.
methods.context: Chame com um Game_Actor existente como this, por .call(actor). A posição de cada item corresponde ao slot; slots vazios retornam null. ClassChangeSystem usa esta leitura durante a ação do ator para evitar recursão no cálculo de múltiplas classes. A leitura normal actor.equips() continua aplicando os filtros ativos.
